messages:
ajay: Heads-up — noticed a weird auth fallback behavior in prod canary. When SA token exchange fails the request attribution falls back to the org default key instead of the originating project. Saw a spike in org-level quota consumption on telemetry. Anyone else seeing this?
sophia: Yep, saw the same on the auth-exchange dashboard this morning. Roughly ~1.2% of exchanges hitting the edge proxy show the fallback. Do we have repro steps?
ajay: Repro is straightforward: force an exchange with an expired proxy credential -> gateway returns 403 -> auth-router goes into 'stitch' path and rewrites attribution to `org-default`. Log snippet: ```auth-router: exchange failed code=403; fallback=org-default; decision=stitch```
kevin: @ajay that 'stitch' path was added intentionally to avoid noisy 401s for consumers during the rollout. Looks like an unintended quota misattribution side-effect. We should gate it.
maria: Can we gate with a rollout flag `auth.stitch_allow` and default it OFF for sensitive orgs? Also need a console widget / alert for sudden org quota jumps.
sam: Agreed. Minimal action plan: 1) set flag false for canary 2) emit metric `auth.exchange.fallback` with tags {orig_project, org_id, reason} 3) add alert -> ops. I'll draft PR.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary roll started: auth-router v2.14 -> rolling to us-west-2 (pods healthy: 3/3) :rocket:
sophia: Also consider returning 401 and surfacing the error to caller. Stitching hides root cause and makes debugging harder.
kevin: Returning 401 will break some older SDKs that expect graceful fallbacks. Product needs to weigh UX vs billing correctness. @maria can you check billing impact and recommend?
maria: @kevin from billing point-of-view misattribution can incorrectly consume reserved quota and trigger throttles for orgs. Prefer explicit failure by default. I'll have ops tag high-risk orgs and request opt-in for stitch.
ajay: I'll open a short RFC for the feature flag and include proposed metrics/dashboards. Sam — can you add `first_seen` dimension so we can surface new orgs that suddenly get fallbacks?
sam: Yep. PR incoming for metric + grafana dashboard in ~2 hrs. Will add alert: trigger when fallback_rate > 0.5% OR hourly delta > 50% over baseline.
kevin: Also suggest we sample 100% of fallback events to tracing for 24h retention (short-term) so we can replay root cause.
sophia: Add to RFC: preserve token lineage in logs (fields `orig_project_id`, `attempted_sa`, `exchange_error`) so we can debug attribution vs stitch decisions.
ajay: Perfect. Pausing broader rollout until `auth.stitch_allow` default is false and dashboard + alert in place. I'll update the canary checklist. Thanks all.
